page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Marginal line numbers (5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35) in the right margin, each beside its line. Running head at top. Page number at top left. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.l: præ somno, in concione Pauli, qui ipsum ex morte su-s-
citat.
413. Trophimus, civis pius Ephesi, Paulum comitatur ex
Asiâ Hierosolymam. Docuit Arelate in Galliis.
414. Lysias, cognomento Claudius, tribunus Hieroso-
lymitanus, Paulum à Iudæis comprehensum, periculo
eripit.
415. Ananias, Pontifex Maximus, iubet cædere os Pau-
li apostoli. Tertullus, Ananiæ orator, est similis domino suo.
416. Aristarchus, fuit collega, comes & concaptivus
Pauli.
417. Iulius, centurio cohortis Augustæ, Cæsareæ, Pau-
lum humaniter habitum perducit Romam.
418. Publius, præfectus Melitæ, Paulum peramicè acci-
pit hospitio.
419. Clemens, Pauli collega, docuit Metis.
420. Philemon, civis pius Thessalonicæ, fuit adiutor
Pauli. Archippus, ibidem fuit Pauli commilito.
421. Onesimus, servus Philemonis fugitivus, concilia-
tur hero literis Pauli.
422. Electa, fuit fœmina præstantis dignitatis, cui Io-
hannes inscripsit secundam suam epistolam.
423. Gaius, patriâ Derbensis, incolatu Corinthius, fuit
pietate & hospitalitate insignis. Huic inscripsit Iohannes
tertiam suam epistolam.
424. Itali, quorum fit mentio Hebr.13. erant sancti qui-
dam in Italiâ, Iudæi procul dubio & Gentes.
425. Phœbe, Epenatus, & alij, quorum mentio fit Rom.16.
& illi, qui recitantur 1. Cor.16. Phil.4. Coloss.4. 2. Tim.4.&
Tit.3. hi, inquam, ex allegatis locis cognosci possunt qua-
les fuerint.
Hic itaque manum de tabulâ prosopographiæ sacræ
tollo, eamq; hoc duplici nomine tibi commendatam esse
cupio: quòd videlicet insigniter faciat ad facilem recor-
dationem historiarum per universum Scripturæ corpus

page.notes: The marginal numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are printed line counts in the right margin, each beside its line; they are kept as notes at that place. "Epenatus" is transcribed as printed; the standard spelling is Epenetus. "Hebr.13." is printed without a space after the abbreviation; kept as printed. The word at the foot right, "spar.", is the catchword. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout (for example "Hieroso-lymitanus", "secundam").
